whatIsIt.eli5: Grades how right the model was about what each thing is.
whatIsIt.simple: Binary cross-entropy compares each predicted class score with the target (the TAL quality score for positives, 0 for background). Weight 0.5 by default.
whatIsIt.engineer: BCEWithLogits over all anchors × classes, soft targets from normalised alignment metric; gain cls = 0.5.

whyExists.eli5: The model needs to know when it named something wrong.
whyExists.simple: Treating each class as its own yes/no question lets one box score several classes independently and handles background naturally.
whyExists.engineer: Sigmoid-BCE (vs softmax CE) supports multi-label scores and quality-aware targets.
